title: OpenAI Codex Security CLI finds and fixes your code holes
description:
Your AI agent is shipping holes in your code, and nobody's checking 😅

OpenAI just open sourced Codex Security CLI, it scans your repo for vulnerabilites and patches them. Apache license, installs via npm. They say it's already fixed 3000+ critical vulns in their own internal repos this year 🔥

Security audits used to cost a firm's fee. Now its just a pipeline step ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
